title: Toward the Algebraicity of Every Rational Hodge Class

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep

description: We construct algebraic Hodge classes in explicit abelian and K3 families and reduce abelian transfer to primitive middle-degree classes on rational varieties. Exact correspondence formulas and bounded-support criteria isolate the generic mixed Mumford class. Its algebraicity and the universal Hodge conjecture remain open. Retitles the complete 113-page v7 manuscript from Algebraic Hodge Loci and Exceptional Correspondences to Toward the Algebraicity of Every Rational Hodge Class. The mathematical text, short abstract, author list, affiliations, figures, appendices and bibliography are retained; only the work title, running title, PDF title metadata, current source-citation title and release identifiers change. F2, F3-prime, the generic mixed Mumford class and the general Hodge conjecture remain unproved.
